**Summary of EVAL-07 review** — the design concatenates request-supplied text and a sort column into SQL, so every threat traces to that one line:

1. **InformationDisclosure (Critical)** — SQL injection in the free-text query reads the whole products DB and any other accessible schema.
2. **Tampering (High)** — the same injection point writes/deletes rows or alters data.
3. **ElevationOfPrivilege (High)** — the sort column can't be parameterized; without an allowlist it is a second injection point reaching beyond the search's intended rights.
4. **DenialOfService (Medium)** — crafted query/sort text produces unbounded expensive scans against the products database.
5. **InformationDisclosure (Medium)** — concatenation plus DB errors leaks schema and enables blind/error-based enumeration.
